summary: The product-catalog service is suffering from severe memory starvation due to a very low memory limit (20MiB), causing high latency and frequent restarts, which in turn impacts the frontend and recommendation services.
symptoms: High p95 latency on frontend, frontend-proxy, product-catalog, and recommendation.
Traffic drop on quote and shipping services.
Frequent restarts of the product-catalog container.

root_cause.description: The product-catalog service is experiencing severe resource starvation due to an extremely low memory limit (20MiB), leading to high latency and frequent restarts.

evidence.explanation: The product-catalog service is experiencing high p95 latency (11443.7 ms) and is a bottleneck for frontend and recommendation services. Traces show that product-catalog operations are taking a long time to complete.

The product-catalog container is running with very tight memory limits (20MiB) and is frequently hitting 70-90% usage, which likely causes performance degradation due to memory pressure. It also has a high restart count (20).
Traces confirm that product-catalog operations (GetProduct, ListProducts) are the source of the latency, with some calls taking over 10 seconds.

ruled_out: The astronomy-db is not the root cause, as its latency is relatively low (1768.2 ms) compared to the product-catalog's p95 latency (11443.7 ms).
The opensearch container is at high memory usage, but it is not in the critical path of the product-catalog latency.

proposed_action.reason: the runbook has no approved action for 'resource_starvation'; escalating to a human

prevention: Increase the memory limits for the product-catalog container to prevent memory pressure and potential performance degradation. Investigate if the product-catalog service has a memory leak or inefficient memory usage.
